works.title: Migrant Mother
works.at: Library of Congress, Washington (Farm Security Administration collection)
works.note: Made for a U.S. government agency, so the photograph is in the public domain. The mother, Florence Owens Thompson, later said she was never paid and wished the picture had not made her a symbol.
